values.note: Creek-side full-hookup sites, full hookups in the "Island", and electric-and-water sites; all with 20/30/50 amp. Sites are "rated true to size" on the booking engine: pick one your rig fits. One RV per site; no cargo or flatbed trailers in tow, no car camping, converted buses or tiny houses; RVs must meet ANSI/RVIA standards. Tent sites April-October only, booked in person or by phone.

sites.source: https://www.cityofgolden.gov/community/recreation/clear_creek_rv_park/rates_fees.php (site types; 'All RVs must meet ANSI & RVIA standards'; 'Absolutely NO car camping, converted buses, cargo trailers or tiny houses') + https://www.cityofgolden.gov/community/recreation/clear_creek_rv_park/park_guidelines.php ('Our sites are rated true to size...'; 'Only one RV is allowed per RV site'; 'cargo and or flatbed trailers in tow with RV's ... NOT permitted'). No city page gives a site length; the stored 45 ft rested on note prose from a directory and is cleared, read 2026-10-26

values.note: Free showers and coin laundry, open 24 hours except 11 am-12:30 pm cleaning; dump station at the park entrance. No wood or charcoal fires (gas grills allowed), no generators.

facilities.source: https://www.cityofgolden.gov/community/recreation/clear_creek_rv_park/index.php ('Free wi-fi', 'Free showers', 'Coin-operated laundry facilities') + https://www.cityofgolden.gov/community/recreation/clear_creek_rv_park/park_guidelines.php ('Laundry & Restrooms are open 24 hours a day and are closed daily for cleaning from 11 am to 12:30 pm'; 'Please use the dump station located at the entrance/exit of the park'; ember-emitting fire and generator bans), read 2026-10-26

season.source: https://www.cityofgolden.gov/community/recreation/clear_creek_rv_park/index.php ('Open year-round with both daily reservations and seasonal extended stays available') + https://www.cityofgolden.gov/community/recreation/clear_creek_rv_park/rates_fees.php ('2026 RV SITE DAILY RATE (Available Year-Round)'), read 2026-10-26

values.note: Reservation-only: book online or at the office (303-278-1437, 9 am-4 pm daily); sites open 60 days ahead at midnight Mountain time. Daily stays are capped at 14 nights in any 30. Monthly extended stays November 1-March 31 go by application and lottery (posted early September); daily sites stay bookable all year.

booking.source: https://www.cityofgolden.gov/community/recreation/clear_creek_rv_park/park_guidelines.php ('The Clear Creek RV Park is a reservation-only facility'; 'The earliest reservations can be made is 60-days from the current date'; '14-nights within a 30-day period') + https://www.cityofgolden.gov/community/recreation/clear_creek_rv_park/faq.php ('Sites become available 60-days (8 weeks plus 4 days) at midnight MST/MDT'; lottery) + https://www.cityofgolden.gov/community/recreation/clear_creek_rv_park/index.php ('Book Online' link; Office Hours 9 am - 4 pm), read 2026-10-26

values.note: 2026 daily rates: electric and water $68, full hookup in the "Island" $75, creek-side full hookup $85, plus tax ($77.18-$96.48 with tax); for one RV, one extra vehicle and five people, $5 per extra person. Extended stays (November-March) $1,249-$1,349 a month.

fees.source: https://www.cityofgolden.gov/community/recreation/clear_creek_rv_park/rates_fees.php ('2026 RV SITE DAILY RATE (Available Year-Round) Creek-side Full Hookup $85 + tax ($96.48) / Full Hookup in the "Island" $75 + tax ($85.13) / Electric & Water (no sewer) $68 + tax ($77.18)'; extended stay rates), read 2026-10-26

note: City of Golden municipal RV park on the banks of Clear Creek at 1401 10th St, a half-mile walk along the creek path to downtown Golden; the Golden Community Center (pools, gym) is across the street. --Claude
summary: City of Golden pages: added $68-$85 2026 daily rates, 20/30/50-amp + water at every site and sewer at the full-hookup sites, free showers/coin laundry/dump/WiFi, year-round daily reservations (60-day window, 14 nights in 30, reservation-only) with monthly extended stays Nov-Mar by lottery. Cleared max_rig_ft 45 (no city source; booking engine is Cloudflare-walled). Long-stay check: nightly sites are sold all year and the monthly season is a separate application, so not a seasonal-residential park. Note cleaned of field facts. Phone 303-278-1437 matches.
flags: Waterfront re-audit: the city says the park sits 'on the banks of Clear Creek' and offers 'Creek-side sites' (the $85 tier), while the entry is 'riverview'. Per the contrary-claims rule this should go back through the waterfront gate (imagery of the creek-side row).
